walkthroughs.body_html:
Theme 3: Communication and the World Around Us — a core area of GCSE German.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Theme 3: Communication and the World Around Us brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Theme 3: Communication and the World Around Us.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: In 'Heute gehe ich ins Kino', why does 'gehe' come second?
options: Heute is always followed by a verb.
Word order is free.
Ich gehe Kaffee trinken morgen.
German is a V2 language - the conjugated verb is the second element in main clauses.

mcqs.q: How do you say 'I will drink coffee tomorrow' in German?
options: Ich werde morgen Kaffee trinken.
Ich will Kaffee morgen trinken.
Ich gehe Kaffee trinken morgen.
Heute is always followed by a verb.

mcqs.q: Where does 'nicht' go in 'I don't like the film' (Der Film gefällt mir nicht)?
options: At the end (negating the whole sentence).
Before the verb.
Right after the subject.
Heute is always followed by a verb.
